rules.message: The invoice carries no specification identifier (BT-24).
The invoice carries no invoice number (BT-1).
The invoice carries no issue date (BT-2).
The invoice carries no invoice type code (BT-3).
The invoice carries no invoice currency code (BT-5).
The invoice names no seller (BT-27).
The invoice names no buyer (BT-44).
The invoice carries no postal address of the seller (BG-5).
The postal address of the seller carries no country code (BT-40).
The invoice carries no postal address of the buyer (BG-8).
The postal address of the buyer carries no country code (BT-55).
The document totals carry no sum of the line net amounts (BT-106).
The document totals carry no total amount without VAT (BT-109).
The document totals carry no total amount with VAT (BT-112).
The document totals carry no amount due for payment (BT-115).
The invoice has no invoice line (BG-25).
A payee (BG-10) is named only when it differs from the seller: it needs a name (BT-59) and must not share the seller's name or identifiers.
The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no name (BT-62).
The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no postal address (BG-12).
The postal address of the seller's tax representative carries no country code (BT-69).
The invoice line carries no line identifier (BT-126).
The invoice line carries no invoiced quantity (BT-129).
The invoiced quantity of the invoice line carries no unit of measure (BT-130).
The invoice line carries no net amount (BT-131).
The invoice line carries no item name (BT-153).
The invoice line carries no item net price (BT-146).
The item net price (BT-146) of the invoice line is missing or negative.
The item gross price (BT-148) of the invoice line is negative.
The end date of the invoicing period (BT-74) lies before its start date (BT-73).
The end date of the invoice line period (BT-135) lies before its start date (BT-134).
The document level allowance carries no amount (BT-92).
The document level allowance carries no VAT category code (BT-95).
The document level allowance carries neither a reason (BT-97) nor a reason code (BT-98).
The document level charge carries no amount (BT-99).
The document level charge carries no VAT category code (BT-102).
The document level charge carries neither a reason (BT-104) nor a reason code (BT-105).
The invoice line allowance carries no amount (BT-136).
The invoice line allowance carries neither a reason (BT-139) nor a reason code (BT-140).
The invoice line charge carries no amount (BT-141).
The invoice line charge carries neither a reason (BT-144) nor a reason code (BT-145).
The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category taxable amount (BT-116).
The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category tax amount (BT-117).
The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category code (BT-118).
The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category rate (BT-119), which only the category 'O', not subject to VAT, may leave out.
The payment instructions carry no payment means type code (BT-81).
The credit transfer carries no payment account identifier (BT-84).
The payment card primary account number (BT-87) is longer than 10 characters; an invoice carries at most its last digits, never the full number.
The additional supporting document carries no reference (BT-122).
The invoice carries a VAT accounting currency code (BT-6) but no total VAT amount in that currency (BT-111).
The item attribute (BG-32) carries no name (BT-160) or no value (BT-161).
The preceding invoice reference (BG-3) carries no preceding invoice number (BT-25).
The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no VAT identifier (BT-63).
The deliver to address (BG-15) carries no country code (BT-80).
The payment means type code (BT-81) names a credit transfer, but the invoice carries no payment account identifier (BT-84).
The electronic address of the seller (BT-34) names no scheme.
The electronic address of the buyer (BT-49) names no scheme.
The item standard identifier (BT-157) names no scheme.
The item classification identifier (BT-158) names no scheme.
